def transform(grid):
    """Return the input grid tiled in four orientations clockwise."""
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [list(grid[r]) + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)]
    half += [counterclockwise[r] + list(grid[::-1][r][::-1]) for r in range(n)]
    return half
